# The manual-config outgoing-error assertion reads the incoming target

After editing the outgoing hostname, this task checks isHidden on incomingConfigTemplate/#incomingHostnameErrorMessage, but its message says the outgoing error should be hidden. The mismatch is inherited and remains in the accepted source; it is not introduced by the wait changes. This assertion cannot prove the named outgoing error is hidden. No failing runtime was reproduced.

Scope: Account Hub test assertion accuracy.

## Evidence

[Lesson record](../records/c74917eceaaf6b4707c006800b5b2b33ee015438074ec22177ee971d2715335f.json).
